items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: this is myself, Roy Eldridge, Percy Heath, Lloyd Glenn on the piano... and... Eddie Locke was on drums... I received a thousand dollars to make the date.

ctx.x: the guy didn't want him, and I said, let the manplay, what the heck. Its my gig, I can hire who I want to.
I just have one last question for you Tiny, and that is does any bods still call you Lloyd?
Well the only person that ever really called me Lloyd was Charlie Parker, all that time, he never said "Tiny" he say, "hey Lloyd." I say, "oh man, knock it off."
